name: Morozumi Kozue
source:
The landlord's daughter. She often goes up to the hero's room.
She's pretty aggressive and liberating about the ecchi.
She has a cute face but she's slightly awkward.
"Now ... in spite of a man, I can't boil it. It ’s good because I’m saying I’m good!"
